scene.name: ATRIUM 100
scene.geometry_scope: Continuous unfolded 2D native network; floor rise is display metadata, not a 3D force model.

model_spec.label: Generalized Centrifugal Force
model_spec.footprint_note: Native speed-dependent ellipses, recorded each tick before and after commands; original reference-disk audit also retained.
model_spec.comparison_note: CFS v1/v2 share an algorithm; model parameters and native defaults differ across other models. No calibration claim.
model_spec.controller_note: Explicit native-speed braking plus desired-speed control; original native force integration and ellipse parameters remain in use.

contact_guard.name: GCFM native ellipse braking controller
contact_guard.yield_start_clearance: min(2 mm, half of the observed positive start gap), with 0.1 nm numerical floor; original fixed body radii are retained
contact_guard.yield_mode: Pause other members of the observed contact component; reserve release persists until separation exceeds 0.08 m.
contact_guard.native_engine: JuPedSim 1.4.2, default force parameters, mass=1, tau=0.5
contact_guard.scope: Supplemental braking of actual native speed plus desired-speed caps. Not unmodified GCFM dynamics. All observed positions remain native.

metrics.arrival_rule: Observed saved native centre at least 0.6 m beyond a grade-level final discharge inside its outdoor annex.

stair_command_audit.scope: Actually applied desired speed after guard/yield, at every native integration tick inside a stair.

audit.footprint_scope: Native speed-dependent ellipses plus retained reference-disk diagnostics

native_ellipse.scope: Native speed-dependent ellipses at every saved pre-command and applied state; support-function separation and conservative continuous ellipse envelopes. Any unresolved envelope fails. Zero-metre acceptance threshold.
native_ellipse.orientation_at_rest: When the native orientation is zero, use the circle enclosing all ellipse orientations; never collapse a body.
native_ellipse.collision_proof: Known-heading inscribed ellipse polygons, or minimum-axis disks for unknown heading. Outer-envelope overlap without an inner intersection is unresolved and still fails.

pedpy.scope: Native unfolded-coordinate human speeds; separate floor concourse densities. Not pressure or calibrated risk.
